snippet.title: Bogey Dead 6 (1996) PS1 - Gameplay HD
snippet.description:
Bogey Dead 6 is a 1996 flight simulation video game developed by Pegasus Japan and Bit Town, and published by Asmik in Japan and Sony in other regions. The game features six real fighter planes: the F-4E, F-14D, F-15E, F-16C, F/A-18E and the F-22 Raptor.

Initial release date: January 26, 1996
Mode: Multiplayer video game
Developer: Asmik Ace
Series: Sidewinder
Platform: Playstation
Genres: Simulation Video Game, Action game, Simulation Game
Publishers: Asmik Ace, Sony Interactive Entertainment
